verdicts.note: S1 (pamphlet p.10) confirms a decade in the office, from field appraiser to Business Applications Administrator, 'the trust and support of the current Assessor and staff', and no elected experience. S3 lists Assessor Drew, Chief Deputy Rebic and about 20 office staff. A continuity profile without an elected record fits -1, not -2.

S1 shows a mixed profile. She has an appointed 2019 Lacey council seat and county executive-administration roles, and she runs as the change-of-management candidate against the office's continuity pick. Neither the record pole nor the renewal pole dominates, so 0 fits.

The cited text checks out: 'county budgets are tight ... manage resources responsibly' (S1) and 'fiscal responsibility' (S2). This is generic office-management language, not a position on public investment levels, so the existing low confidence is the right ceiling. The mild restraint direction holds.
